Recap Time!

Phantaskippy turned the game on its head by bringing everyone into Soviet Russia. This temporarily freed him from his speech impediments and heightened BlueHairedMeerkat's to such a degree that he was forced to communicate through images.

BlueHairedMeerkat tried to retcon this, but only succeeded in redacting Ronway's card play, thanks in part to Magical Girl's reversed powers going haywire.

Ronway refused to have the tables turned on his Pact, and willingly broke it so as to keep his cards.

Silverleaf had had enough of this Soviet nonsense, and used her Dragoneot's Aerial Ace to pull it out of the game. It is now being closely guarded in the immense treasure horde of cards that is her hand. Then she channeled the wrath of her profile picture, attempting a murder... of crows. On BlueHairedMeerkat.

jsz2 used their Tentatortle to wash away the last of the weirdness brought on by Soviet Russia: [REDACTED], which had been changed by cards in a really confusing manner. Both [REDACTED] and the censored card beneath it were sent back to BlueHairedMeerkat's hand. They then swung a magically-enhanced sword at his Pochimera, with enough power to knock that Magnebro into negative hit points if it's not blocked.

A Humble-Knight then joined the game, bringing with them a Slowfable, which Charmed phantaskippy. They then summoned an aspect of Ronway: The Ronway of Not Caring! Now they don't care about losing points as much.
